lines.t: [Intro: Cold Space Ambience, Distant Shofar, Heartbeat]
Before the stars had names,
Before the dust had breath,
A light was lifted high in Eden,
And pride was born from it.
I was the seal of perfection,
Covered in fire and stone.
I walked the mountain of God,
Blazing on a throne.
But something cold woke up in me,
A hunger for the sky.
I'll raise my seat above the stars,
And no one will ask me why.
Behold... behold...
The nations will come to me.
Behold... behold...
The whole world on its knees.
[Drop 1: Heavy Bass, Dark Arpeggio]
I will profane the Name!
I will pollute the Majesty!
I will deceive the whole world,
They will worship only me!
Who will save them from my snares?
Who will break my chain?
Darkness will prevail,
And the King will fall in shame!
I built a thousand idols,
Gold and glitter, lies in light.
They'll hate the God of Israel,
They'll turn from His chosen sight.
My servant at my right hand,
We'll raise a mighty horde.
An army marching through the dark
Against the coming Lord.
But the heavens are holding their breath,
The stars are going still,
A thunder starts to rumble
On the everlasting hill.
[Interlude: Total Silence, Then One Massive Brass Hit]
BEHOLD, I AM AGAINST YOU, SATAN!
Even I, YAHUWAH,
The Father of all nations,
Am against you.
[Dialogue: Dark Pulse, Two Voices Answering]
Who are You to stop my hand?
I have the nations in my grip.
I made you, and I made the stars.
Your breath is Mine to give.
I have set my snares,
I have set my snares,
There is no way out.
There is no way out.
I have set My Son,
And He has come to tear them down.
[Build: Snare Roll, Choir Rising]
You shall be brought down to shame!
[Drop 2: Massive Supersaw Anthem, Orchestral Hits]
Dry grass! Dry grass!
That's all your plans will be!
Dry grass! Dry grass!
Here today, then burned in fire, you'll see!
As the beast treads down the meadow,
So My people tread on you!
All your gods are dry grass,
And I AM THE LORD, it's true!
No... this was not the plan!
The throne was mine to take!
The light that I was born to carry
Is the light that breaks me.
I see Him on the clouds,
The Son of Man in flame.
His eyes are fire, His voice is thunder,
And every knee will say His name!
[Build: Strings Rising]
He comes riding through the dark,
The Morning Star arrives!
The Lion and the Lamb in one,
And every eye will see!
It is finished, Heylel.
[Drop 3: Euphoric EDM, Trumpets]
YahuShua reigns! YahuShua reigns!
The Son of Man has won!
The sword is in His mouth,
The war is over, it is done!
Cast down from the mountain,
Swept out of Eden's stone,
The cherub is ashes on the ground,
And the King is on His throne!
[Breakdown: Solo Piano, Trembling Voice]
I was in the snare,
I once believed his lie.
I was lost in the dark,
Then YahuShua heard my cry.
He took my chains away,
He called me by my name.
Now I'm standing in the light,
And I'll never be the same.
[Build: Male Choir Rising, Snare Roll, Shofar]
Come, My sheep. The gate is open.
The wolves are gone.
The Kingdom is here
